verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover both halves of the story. One page covers changing kitty colors and another covers automatically changing color themes when the OS switches between light and dark, backed by kitty.conf color configuration and wide-gamut color formats. The evidence consists of page titles only, without detail on how theme selection or the automatic switching works. Missing for 10: documented detail on theme browsing/selection and on how auto-switching is configured, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of the light/dark switching.
